Source placement/wire/label parsing is shared; annotation graphics and fabrication approval are excluded.

oscillator_interface.scope: Pin/footprint identity and capacitance allocation only; extracted load and waveform qualification remain open.

assumptions.request_protocol: RUN high requests continuous cycles. RUN low finishes an already-started cycle, after synchronization latency. A rising debounced STEP while READY and idle sets a pending latch; ACTIVE clears it after acceptance. Holding STEP high does not repeat. STEP during an active cycle is ignored. Raw switch debounce and HALT/CONTINUE arbitration are external to this core.
assumptions.reset_protocol: RESET_IN_n asynchronously aborts the current cycle. Receivers must remain inhibited during reset and until controller initialization. Release only after supply is valid and the oscillator startup interval has elapsed. READY is an internal reset-sequencing indication, not a power-good detector.
assumptions.receiver_duty_scope: Assumed digital threshold-duty stress range; the manufacturer only bounds 45/55 duty at half supply.

unqualified: Oscillator cycle-to-cycle jitter is not bounded in the cited data sheet; 2 ns internal and 10 ns output uncertainty are allocated design limits.
Maximum propagation bounds are used at their data-sheet input-slew and load conditions; source-to-receiver slew compatibility needs electrical modelling or measurements.
Trace capacitance, connector loading and clock routing allocations need extracted PCB evidence.
The asynchronous request and reset entry stages have no metastability MTBF qualification.
Front-panel debounce, HALT/CONTINUE arbitration, power supervisor, receiver reset inhibition and backplane hookup remain to be implemented.
Exact passive parts, distributor availability, footprint review and independent review remain open.
ACH edge measurement levels and monotonic threshold crossing are not specified in the archived family sheet.
Nominal 45/55 duty applies at half supply. The 37/63 receiver-duty sweep is a hypothetical sensitivity, not a guaranteed oscillator limit.
ACH standard load is 15 pF, including the 10 pF AHCT04 input and all routing/socket/probe capacitance.

fd1.title: FD1 flash machine with clock/reset and private DATA distribution
fd1.summary: 8/8 continuous and 3/3 all-opcode profiles; 324 connector links; 9/9 wiring mutations and 28/28 receiver guards; conditional 4 MHz target, 8 MHz rejected.
fd1.limitation: AL2 occupies the AL1 connector slot. Each link allocates 10 pF total trace/connector load. Partial interval/load coverage, exact oscillator, qualified reset, private SRAM turnaround, full-temperature capacitance and physical routing remain open. No physical-clock or MOD-08 acceptance is implied.
